column1: # kext-local marker overlay (T6). The shared nextbsd-ci manifest (markers.tsv)
# is checked out at the pinned tag and loaded first; this overlay adds the GPU
# marker the kext image's booted guest binds, so the kext repo version-codes its
# own assertion without a nextbsd-ci tag bump.
# VIRTIO: the shared harness boots both arches with -device virtio-gpu-pci, so
# the binding GPU kext is VirtIOGraphics. fail-gates: a -FAIL (the GPU kext did
# not come up) is a real graphics regression and fails the boot; a bare absence
# does not gate (the marker only exists if the on-image suite actually ran the

column6: T6 GPU validation: kext image's booted guest (virtio-gpu, both arches) must have VirtIOGraphics autoloaded + bound; a -FAIL is a graphics regression.
